parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The AppName of the live stream. The AppName must match that in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. The value is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: BizType
parameters.description: The business type. This parameter can be used to select a model. The default value is the domain name.

parameters.name: OssBucket
parameters.description: The name of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: OssEndpoint
parameters.description: The endpoint of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: OssObject
parameters.description: The name of the recording file stored in OSS.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. The StreamName must match that in the ingest URL for the template to take effect. The value is case-sensitive.
